items.title: Project Meridian FX APAC: Policy Report
items.content: This page summarises the policy findings of Project Meridian FX APAC, a joint experiment on synchronisation in FX between the Bank of England, Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank of Thailand, with the Reserve Bank of Australia and Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas as observers. It sets out the key policy conclusions from the experiment and considerations for a live service.

Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
items.content: Scientists have discovered that vitamin C may help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming in the stomach after eating foods containing nitrates and nitrites. A new mathematical model suggests that taking vitamin C after meals could reduce these harmful reactions, offering a possible new strategy for lowering cancer risk.

items.title: NASA warns this year's Monster El Niño could be even bigger than legendary 1997 event
items.content: NASA scientists warn that the rapidly intensifying 2026 El Niño could surpass the historic 1997-98 event, which triggered devastating weather extremes around the world. Satellite data reveal striking similarities between the two, raising the possibility of major rainfall and flooding this winter, although the exact impacts remain uncertain.
